findings.title: Task 2's input.ts edits are quoted from before asteroids-ii and match nothing on master
findings.claim: Four of Task 2 Step 4's quoted 'Replace' blocks in app/duel/input.ts don't match current master. Asteroids-ii added `rockLock?` to ConsoleInput and `rockTo` to the keyboard. If an executor pasted the plan's replacement text anyway, rockTo would be lost from clear() and sample().
findings.evidence: plan L511 quotes ConsoleInput as one line ending `frequency(freq: number): void }`; master input.ts:36-38 ends `frequency(freq: number): void;` and then has the `rockLock?(weapon, rock): void }` member. Plan L529 `let presses = …` has no `rockTo`; master input.ts:105 does. Plan L538 `const clear` has no `rockTo = null`; master input.ts:125 does. Plan L551-552 (sample's `out` and its reset) have no rockTo; master input.ts:148-149 do. Only `frequency(freq) { freqTo = freq; }` (plan L544, input.ts:140) still matches. Existing test tests/duelRuntime.test.ts:457-458 drives `rockTo`.
findings.why: An executor can't apply the edits as written. A forced paste breaks the rock-target clear that asteroids-ii relies on, along with its tests.
findings.fix: Re-quote all four edits from master. ConsoleInput: insert the `ship?` member after the `rockLock?` member, before the closing `}`. Keep `rockTo` in the `let`, in clear(), in the `out` literal and in the reset line, and add only `ship` / `ship = []`.

findings.title: Task 8's WeaponsStation rewrite drops asteroids-ii's rock targeting, and an existing test imports what it removes
findings.claim: Step 10 replaces the whole of WeaponsStation.tsx with a version written before asteroids-ii. It removes `export const WEAPONS_HINT`, the `rock` parameter of `targetText`, the cards' right-click `rockLock?(weapon, -1)` clear, 'TGT ROCK', and the `ROCKS n` count. The plan never states or justifies this regression. tsc -b and vitest will fail.
findings.evidence: plan L2131: `targetText = (room: number)`, with no WEAPONS_HINT, no rockLock and no ROCKS line (L2101-2229). Master WeaponsStation.tsx:30 has `targetText(room, rock = false)`, :42 has `actions.console.rockLock?.(weapon, -1)`, :63 has `export const WEAPONS_HINT`, :72/84/93 have the rock flags, and :108 has `ROCKS ${weapons.rocks}`. tests/rockTargetUi.test.tsx:13 imports `{ targetText, WEAPONS_HINT }`, :38 calls `targetText(1, true)`, and :59-62 assert WEAPONS_HINT and the ROCKS width. tsconfig.web.json includes `tests/**/*`. Step 11 (L2237) does not run rockTargetUi.
findings.why: The task fails its `npx tsc -b` gate. Even after patching, it silently removes the shipped rock-target UI, which spec §11 does not ask for.
findings.fix: Rewrite Step 10 on top of master's file. Keep targetText(room, rock), WEAPONS_HINT, the rock-aware right-click clear (in Pick), TGT ROCK on BEAM and TORPEDO, and the ROCKS count. Then fit FREE and the pip hint around them, and add tests/rockTargetUi.test.tsx to Step 11's run list.

findings.title: Task 8's model edits also predate asteroids-ii: the WeaponsPanel quote doesn't match, and the laserSituation quote matches twice
findings.claim: Step 4's WeaponsPanel replacement quotes a line that no longer closes the interface. Step 6's `laserSituation` replacement text now appears twice: once in the rock-target branch and once in the enemy branch. Two executors would edit different lines. Separately, the Task 8 model test clears rocks the pre-asteroids way.
findings.evidence: plan L1908 quotes `… refused?: RefusedView | null }`; consoleModel.ts:37 ends `refused?: RefusedView | null;` and is followed by :38-40 `laserRock?; torpRock?; torpRockFlying?; rocks?: number }`. plan L1991 `  if (laserOffline(t, CREW_SLOT)) return { kind: 'offline' };` matches situationModel.ts:46 (inside the `sysRock.laserRock >= 0` branch) and :59. plan L1881 resets only `t.map.asteroids` and `t.grid`, while the repo's own helper tests/feelIiModels.test.ts:46 also resets `st.rocks = initRocks(st.map)`, because lineOfSight now walks the rock pool (geometry.ts:26).
findings.why: Step 4 can't be applied as written. In Step 6, if only :59 is edited, a beam-dark ship aiming at a rock still shows WEAPONS OFFLINE on the BEAM card, which contradicts Decision 14.
findings.fix: Quote L37-40 and insert `weaponBars?: number[]; weaponFree?: number` before `rocks?: number }`. State that both laserOffline lines (:46 and :59) get the weaponsOffline treatment, or quote each with its surrounding line. In the test, clear rocks as feelIiModels' clearRocks does (import initRocks).

findings.title: Task 7's pre-flight grep for THROTTLE_CAP_BY_BARS can't match Part i's declaration
findings.claim: Step 1 greps `THROTTLE_CAP_BY_BARS = \[0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 4\]`. Part i declares the table with a type annotation, so the grep prints nothing, and the plan says 'If any prints nothing, stop and report'.
findings.evidence: plan L1434: `git grep -n "THROTTLE_CAP_BY_BARS = \[0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 4\]"`. Part i plan L2021: `export const THROTTLE_CAP_BY_BARS: readonly number[] = [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 4];`.
findings.why: Every executor halts at Task 7 Step 1, even though Part i built exactly the right name.
findings.fix: Grep `THROTTLE_CAP_BY_BARS: readonly number\[\] = \[0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 4\]`, or grep the name alone and check the values in the tests.

findings.title: The fog still gives away an unseen enemy: its exact range in text, the sit-down zoom, and map clicks or pings at its hidden spot
findings.claim:
Task 9 hides the enemy's silhouette, marks and lock, but several other paths still read the real enemy:
- laserSituation returns `{ kind: 'range', range }` for an unseen enemy, so the Weapons status sentence and the BEAM card reason print 'OUT OF RANGE 2134/450'.
- The sit-down zoom frames both ships using the enemy's real position.
- pickContact and pickShip scan every active ship, so a click at the hidden enemy opens its window and a ping snaps onto it.
findings.evidence: situationModel.ts:56 returns the range. weaponsModel.ts:166-169 builds the status sentence from laserSituation whatever `ships` holds. consoleModel.ts:115 builds the card reason from laserSituation. scene.ts:250 `if (e?.active) zoomTo(… frameZoom(e.x - own.x, …))`. scene.ts:184 and :203 pickContact for the click and the ping. tacticalModel.ts:471-475: pickShip loops over all active slots. Plan Task 9 Steps 5 and 8 (L2446-2548) gate only the drawing. Spec §10.4 L431: unseen contacts are drawn as a ghost.
findings.why: A player can learn an unseen enemy's distance and bearing without Sensors power, which undercuts the fog the spike is meant to test.

findings.title: The refused LAUNCH reason now runs into FREE and past the Weapons block
findings.claim: With three 90 px cards, the torpedo card's text starts at tx = 218. 'LAUNCH: OUT OF RANGE' is about 120 px at FONT_NATIVE, which runs to about 338, past `right` (304), over the right-aligned FREE count and outside the 312 px panel. Longer reasons such as TORPEDO UNPOWERED run further. The plan says the text stays clear.
findings.evidence: plan L1940: card x = x0 + i × 96, w 90, so T.x is 212 and tx is 218. plan L2213 draws FREE right-aligned at `right` on row y0+116. plan L2215 draws the refusal at `tx` on the same row. plan L2231 claims '(x 220), which stays clear of FREE'. FONT_NATIVE text is about 6 px per glyph (tests/rockTargetUi.test.tsx:62 budgets textPx(s, 1)).
findings.why: The most common LAUNCH refusal overlaps on the console the owner will play.
findings.fix: Draw every refusal from x0, or move FREE to its own spot (for example under the pips, or on the y0+134 row beside ROCKS). Then add a jsdom or textPx width assertion like rockTargetUi's.

verified:
Part i's names match what Part ii uses:
- power.ts re-exports DuelSystem, DUEL_SYSTEM_COUNT, OVERDRIVE_SYSTEMS, SYSTEM_MAX, SYSTEM_SLOTS, REACTOR_BARS, START_BARS and effectiveBars (Part i L754-756).
- power.ts defines COOLANT_POOL_DUEL=8, capacityOf, sparesOf, coolantFree, isOverdriven and PowerState {heat, coolant, failed: number[]} (L759-781).
- Also matching: fireTileOf(d, room) (L1727), LOW_AIR_FRAC (L1706), and throttleCap(sys: Pick<'rooms'|'bars'>) (L2025).
- Weapons names match: WeaponSlot {Pew:0,Beam:1,Torpedo:2} as const, weaponBarsUsable, trimmedWeaponPower(WeaponSys), weaponBars (L2324-2343), BEAM_SHOTS_BY_BARS [0,1,2,2,2] (L2582), and the command `{ kind: 'weaponPower'; slot; delta }` (L2423).
- Fog names match: sensorRange, pointSeen, shipSeen, contactSeen (L2885-2902), and the four ship commands in contracts (L1120).

No pew pew remnant survives: no pew charge, lock, pick-up, number key or `weapon` field (grep over the plan). This agrees with Part i L68-70 and spec §11 L451-453. Part i's laserOffline (beamShots===0) and canLaunch (torpedo bars ≥1) (Part i L2618-2632) match Task 8's weaponsOffline and refusal ordering.

The helpers the plan relies on exist with the assumed shapes: Placement {scale,x,y} (interiorCamera.ts:12); Derived doorTileToEdge, airlockOfTile, siteRoom, siteTile, roomTiles and volume (derived.ts:11-17); rooms.fireRepair and breaches.repair (state.ts:31,35); DoorState.HeldOpen=3 (grid.ts:4); INTERIOR_BAND y 42 and TILE_PX 32; createInteriorView's defaulted args (interiorView.ts:55); Box attrs, boxCss, CrtProvider/CrtGlow/useCrt, blink and ALERT_BLINK_HZ (crtTheme.ts:14); Button's disabled → aria-disabled, which ignores presses (Button.tsx:45,56); and placeMissile and createCamera.

Hound geometry in the tests: the door at (12,7) is O–Q, the airlock at (0,7) is the Hold's, (14,7) is Quarters floor, and Q's breach site (15,5) is also its fire tile, so the half-tile offset applies (hound.json:108-121,129-133,221-225).

Task 1 layout arithmetic: the panel is x 6–334 and y 557–712. Every layout assertion in tests/shipHudModel's rewrite holds, and the airTint expected values are exact in IEEE doubles (0.15, 0.3 and 0.55).

Online path: Task 3 sends `k.ship` first in onlineDuel's play, which runs only while running, synced, focused and not decided (onlineDuel.ts:260-270). Unfocused pumps drain the keyboard and stopInput clears it (onlineDuel.ts:140,252). The interior-click wiring is gated on `focused && !blocked`, as takeClick is (onlineDuel.ts:304). Ship-command refusals are not surfaced in either mode. The plan lists 'a refusal flash' as a candidate (L2751), and spec §6 doesn't require one.
HUD clicks don't block the interior: the Stage root is pointerEvents:none (Stage.tsx:7), so the nested CrtGlow inset div inherits it, and only the Hit targets set 'auto'.
Ship commands survive a Single-player Tab because runtime's isConsoleCommand (runtime.ts:239) doesn't include them.
Fog state is per screen and deterministic in tests: stepFog takes an explicit `now` and epoch, and the ghost alpha arithmetic is exact (0.9 at 1 s; deleted at 10 s).

Task 11 smoke: the selectors exist (Home.tsx:10 'single-player', ShipPicker.tsx:11 'ship-${id}'), the staging hook sits beside __ftliteDuel (duelMode.ts:81-82), there are exactly nine check() lines, and the output paths are concrete.
